recent_milestones.text: Capacity update: the 500-contribution/day target remains unmet. The original three-source pilot is 3/3 independently source-audited and 0/3 site-integrated. Tirosh’s five record drafts pass the canonical schema; its mapping audit and molecule assets are pending. InP and Cu-Sb-S source extraction are active in separate lanes.

User set a target of at least 500 website paper contributions/day while retaining the existing quality standard. This is a scale-up goal, not an achieved rate; current pilot is source-audited 3/3 and site-integrated 0/3.

Pilot update: all 3/3 extraction packages are frozen and all 3/3 scoped source audits/correction rechecks passed. Tirosh CoFe2O4, Wu Cu2S and phosphinate-ligated CdSe/CdS are ready for canonical reader integration; website integration remains 0/3. CdSe source conflicts remain unresolved and will be shown side by side with locators.

Phosphinate-ligated CdSe main/SI extraction is frozen after all 36 pages and relevant figures/captions were visually reviewed. Ten protocols, sixteen sample contexts and twelve observations keep QD, anisotropic, rod/tetrapod and CdS-rod condition families distinct. Independent audit is underway; no website contribution is published yet.

Pass-screen definition clarified: the 5,587 folder files represent 5,539 distinct contents (48 duplicate copies), and pass means useful synthesis/preparation plus reported structural, phase or morphology evidence—not a verified recipe–structure pair. Two short-paper extraction/audit/recheck cycles pass; matched phosphinate-CdSe main/SI extraction continues. Full-batch finish date remains provisional pending identity grouping and an end-to-end page cycle.

Wu et al. 2008 Cu2S main-article extraction is frozen after complete five-page visual review; independent audit is queued separately after Tirosh 2006. It preserves the growth/wash recipe, exchange/device-stock branch, glass/plastic device workflows, structural/optical outcomes and photovoltaic results. No matching SI candidate was found in the checked screening record, so SI remains unverified. The phosphinate-CdSe main/SI extraction continues.

Tirosh et al. 2006 cobalt ferrite extraction is frozen and hash-validated; its separate source audit has started. The main article coverage includes all six pages, Figures 1–7 and Table 1; SI is not located/verified. Wu et al. 2008 Cu2S and phosphinate-ligated CdSe extraction remain in progress. No new paper from this resumed batch has passed audit or been integrated into the website.

The fixed-folder screen reached 10,702/10,802 distinct document contents (99.074%). Decisions: 5,539 distinct pass contents, 1,666 held, 3,497 no-target and 100 blocked/unreviewed. User-directed deep curation resumed on three source candidates in parallel: Tirosh 2006 cobalt ferrite, Wu 2008 Cu2S, and phosphinate-ligated CdSe. Extraction is in progress; independent audits and website integration are pending. Later arrivals remain separate.

User-directed document-first screening activated: each main article and SI can proceed without prior pairing.13,831fixed copies mapped to12,136distinct content tasks;1,695duplicate copies retained. Existing source reading is reused, not reset. Daily schedule preserved and successive batches requested. No scientific records or screening completions added by this queue change.

Parallel Methods-first screening added 76 provisional scope checks (69 with usable preparation information; 7 deferred or held), plus reuse of one already-closed news scope. 97 provisional scopes now have tracked source-screen receipts, including aliases. Separate bounded checks passed for both mixed batches and the prior second atomic shortlist; selected phase candidates were spot-checked. No new scientific records or exact training pairs were published.

Daily review schedule preserved. First eight shortlisted articles passed a separate bounded synthesis/structure screening audit. A second eight-study batch identified two studies with printed product-coordinate candidates; independent audit and training admission remain pending.

Workflow simplified at user request: Methods/relevant SI first, structure evidence second. Unreadable files are deferred without blocking readable candidates. Full per-paper audits remain required for published data; no new training pairs claimed.

All 238 manual format/text cases are retained for further screening. No scientific records or training pairs were added.

workflow.summary: High-evidence documents are extracted and audited in parallel; source-reviewed records then feed reusable material/method reader pages and separate training exports.
workflow.screening_scope: The fixed screening collection contains 10,802 distinct document contents in 10,967 source files. Main articles and SI are separate documents; exact duplicate contents are counted once in distinct-content rates. The initial screen is 99.074% complete, with 100 access-blocked items still unreviewed. New arrivals remain queued separately.
steps: Screen every fixed-cutoff document independently; preserve source copies, format holds and prior coverage. Missing companions do not block screening.
Rank measured/refined atomic-structure candidates with usable recipes first; keep phase, size and morphology-linked recipes as a separate useful tier.
Verify recipe–sample–structure evidence within each retained source, and verify source relationships when joining information from different documents.
Retain all screened candidates and gaps; external reference cells, simulations and molecular-precursor coordinates do not become measured product pairs.
Build and publish academic material readers only after the selected paper’s source, data, figure and independent audit gates pass.
workflow.capacity: User target: at least 500 source-checked website contributions/day; not achieved. The three-source pilot took roughly 5.5 hours of elapsed time from first recorded extraction milestone to final source-audit milestone and still stands at 0/3 integrated; this heterogeneous pilot interval is not a sustained daily-rate measurement. At a provisional 30–60 min per reviewed source group, 500/day requires 250–500 reviewer-hours/day before integration (32–63 eight-hour reviewers). Continue parallel extraction/audit and batch site builds; keep screen, audit, integration, and publication counts separate.
workflow.paid_processing: No paid API or cloud processing has started; the API pilot remains deferred pending the user’s decision. A local GPU is present, but no inference runtime or model weights are installed, so local AI acceleration is not currently active.
workflow.scheduled_review_frequency: Daily, as set by the user. Published milestone snapshots remain separate from scheduler wakeups.
workflow.screening_count_limit: Includes aliases and prior terminal reuse; no final-disposition or training count implied.
workflow.update_policy: Progress is published at meaningful review milestones. Drafts and source-audit passes are not counted as website contributions; each published record must retain evidence locators and clear source/sample distinctions.

estimate.summary: Target: at least 500 quality-reviewed paper contributions/day. The current three-source pilot has completed extraction and independent audit (3/3) but reader integration is 0/3; provisional time to finish this pilot is 1–3 working days. At the earlier 30–60 min per verified source group, the 500/day target needs about 250–500 reviewer-hours/day before integration, so it is not achievable by merely accelerating the current local manual workflow. A high-throughput batch pipeline and measured pilot are needed; full-collection finish time is not yet a forecast.
estimate.current_batch: Current pilot: Tirosh CoFe2O4, Wu Cu2S and phosphinate-ligated CdSe/CdS (main + matched 24-page SI) have frozen extraction and passed scoped independent audit/correction checks. Reader integration: 0/3 contributions so far. None of these records is training-ready merely because its source audit passes.
notes: Frozen pass-set: 5,539 distinct source contents in 5,587 copied files (48 duplicate copies); main articles and SI are separate screen units, not unique-paper or recipe counts.

A pass means useful synthesis/preparation evidence plus reported structural, phase or morphology evidence. It does not establish a complete procedure, exact recipe-to-specimen linkage, independent audit or training admission.

Distinct source-reported conditions or recipe/sample variants stay separate training records. Papers may add separately attributed evidence to a shared material/method page without merging experiments.

For unresolved source conflicts, retain both claims and show them in parallel with exact main/SI locators and an unresolved label. Do not choose a value or count alternative wording as a separate experiment without evidence of a distinct run.
Pilot pace is not yet a representative or continuous rate. The 1–3-working-day reader-cycle estimate is provisional and excludes papers outside this three-source pilot.

Illustrative backlog arithmetic only: 4,971 provisional identity buckets at 30–60 minutes/group with three eight-hour review lanes imply about 103–207 working days before site integration or identity-resolution overhead. This is not a completion forecast.
Original PDFs and SI remain local. No paid API or cloud processing run has started.

At 500 contributions/day, 4,971 provisional source-group buckets would take about 10 active days by arithmetic alone; 5,539 passing distinct document contents would take about 11 days if they were processed one-for-one. These are lower-bound throughput calculations after the pipeline reaches its target, not a completion forecast; main/SI identity, review depth, conflicts, integration and QA add time.
